lead: Cinematic sci-fi film still, clean bright laboratory, ice blue and mint light.
notes: Mood-only mini images for Collidotron.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen Collidotron-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish Collidotron-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: landfill
images.prompt: A vast old landfill hardened into glittering crystalline stone, being cut into blocks by machines.

images.name: machine
images.prompt: A sleek white reactor machine holding a glowing slab of colored crystal tiles in a titanium frame.

images.name: cascade
images.prompt: Hundreds of tiny glowing orbs bouncing through a shattering lattice of colored glass tiles.

images.name: loaf
images.prompt: A large block of crystalline stone sliced into thin glowing slabs, lined up on a conveyor.

images.name: archive
images.prompt: A quiet gallery wall of framed kaleidoscope tile patterns, softly lit, like an art collection.

images.name: calm
images.prompt: A technician relaxing at a clean control desk, watching a glowing machine at work, evening light.

images.name: nudge
images.prompt: Time slowed almost to a stop, glowing orbs hanging in the air among floating fragments of glass.

images.name: kaleidoscope
images.prompt: A symmetrical kaleidoscope pattern of beveled colored glass tiles, vivid magenta, gold and emerald.

images.name: pebbles
images.prompt: A stream of small polished pebbles of many materials pouring into sorting pipes, metal, ceramic, glass.

images.name: gallery
images.prompt: A grid of nine framed colorful tile patterns arranged three by three on a white wall.
